03

Meet Your Trainer

Dan Darwin — founder & lead trainer

Dan founded the business in 2019 after 12 years in Hampshire Constabulary — as a tutor constable mentoring new officers through their first months on the street, a temporary Sergeant running small teams, and two years seconded to national strategic planning in Westminster, training officers across the country.

"Most people arrive on a mandatory course expecting to be bored. I've spent my career in situations where getting it wrong had consequences — and that's what I bring into the room."
  • 12 years in Hampshire Constabulary (2007–2019), mentoring and training officers
  • NEBOSH General Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety
  • Level 4 Certificate in Education and Training (CET)
  • Mental health training qualifications — NUCO-accredited First Aid for Mental Health instructor (Levels 1–3) and MHFA England trained

About Hello Learn

Learning that sticks — from someone who has lived it

Hello Learn is the new name for Darwin Training Solutions, founded by Dan Darwin in 2019. Accredited courses in health and safety, first aid, security, conflict management, mental health, customer service and leadership — all designed around your business and delivered at your premises.

Book TrainingBrowse Courses
01

Dan's Story

Twelve years on the street. A career in the classroom.

2007 – 2019

Hampshire Constabulary

Twelve years in policing. Dan served as a tutor constable, mentoring new officers through their first months on the street, and as a temporary Sergeant running small teams.

2014 – 2016

National strategic planning, Westminster

Seconded to national strategic planning, travelling to forces across the country to train officers on the Mercury national mutual aid system.

2019

Darwin Training Solutions is founded

Dan leaves policing to build a training business on a simple belief — his goal has always been to make learning stick. The business now relaunches as Hello Learn.

Today

Hello Learn

Bespoke and accredited courses delivered at your premises across Portsmouth, Southampton, Hampshire, the South Coast and London — for security teams, businesses and BIDs across the South.

"My goal has always been to make learning stick."
02

Why the Training Is Different

Real scenarios. Honest conversation. Time to absorb it.

Most people arrive on a mandatory course expecting to be bored. Dan has spent his career in situations where getting it wrong had consequences, and that's what he brings into the room: real scenarios, honest conversation, and a pace that gives people time to actually absorb what they're learning.

The mental health courses in particular draw on his own experience. Candidates consistently say that's what makes them trust the material.

03

04

Talks & Speaking

Bespoke mental health talks

Alongside accredited training, Dan delivers bespoke mental health talks for organisations, events and support groups. In his own words, he talks openly about his personal journey — including his diagnosis for depression, anxiety & OCD, his own suicide attempt, and how he has travelled along his recovery path.

It's this honesty that candidates consistently say makes them trust the material on the mental health courses.

      Privacy Policy

      How Hello Learn handles your information. This concept page summarises the approach in plain English.

      What we collect. When you enquire or request a booking, we receive the details you provide — your name, organisation, contact details and training requirements — so we can respond and arrange your training.

      How we use it. Your details are used only to answer your enquiry, provide quotes, deliver training and meet our legal and awarding-body record-keeping obligations. We do not sell your information.

      This demonstration. The forms on this concept website are front-end demonstrations: nothing you type here is stored, sent or shared.

      Your rights. You can ask what information we hold about you, and ask for it to be corrected or deleted, at any time by emailing dandarwin@darwintrainingsolutions.com or calling +44 (0)7497 504759.

      Legal

      Terms & Conditions

      The essentials for training with Hello Learn, in plain English.

      Booking requests. Submitting a booking request does not confirm a reservation. A booking is only confirmed once Hello Learn has agreed the date, course and price with you directly.

      Prices. Published prices are "from" prices per group of up to 12 learners unless stated per person, and London delivery is priced higher where shown. Your confirmed price is the one agreed in your quote.

      Delivery. On-site courses are delivered at your premises across Portsmouth, Southampton, Hampshire, the South Coast and London. Online courses are self-paced.
